caption: The drawing presents two metallic objects, each resembling a pair of intricately designed scissors or clamps. Both objects are depicted in shades of brown with darker accents, suggesting an aged or rusted metal. Each item has a distinct handle with looped openings for fingers and ornate, decorative elements near the hinge; one handle includes swirled, almost floral patterns and a circular motif with radial lines. The objects are connected with looped chains at one end, and both have a functional, angular design with flat and wide blades that lack sharp edges. The entire composition is set against a blank, cream-colored background, and a small, neat signature or inscription appears slightly to the right of the objects.
title: Bit
